|------------------|--------------|
| **Amazon** | Widely stocked in both paperback and hardcover editions; also available as an eBook (Kindle) and audiobook. |
| **Barnes & Noble** | Offers paperback, hardcover, and Nook eBook versions. |
| **Books-A-Million** | Carries paperback and hardcover copies. |
| **Book Depository** | Free worldwide shipping on paperback and hardcover editions. |
| **Kobo** | Available as an eBook for Kobo readers. |
| **Audible** | Audiobook version narrated by various actors. |
